# PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Contents of this Part

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Title | Number

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Scope of this Part | Rule 38.1

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Right to discontinue claim | Rule 38.2

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Procedure for discontinuing | Rule 38.3

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Right to apply to have notice of discontinuance set aside | Rule 38.4

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] When discontinuance takes effect where permission of the court is not needed | Rule 38.5

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Liability for costs | Rule 38.6

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Discontinuance and subsequent proceedings | Rule 38.7

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE] Stay of remainder of partly discontinued proceedings where costs not paid | Rule 38.8

## Scope of this Part

## 38.1

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] (1) The rules in this Part set out the procedure by which a claimant may discontinue all or part of a claim. A “claim” includes a cause of action or part of one.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] (2) A claimant who –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] (a) claims more than one remedy; and

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] (b) subsequently abandons their claim to one or more of the remedies but continues with their claim for the other remedies,

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] is not treated as discontinuing all or part of a claim for the purposes of this Part.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.1] (The procedure for amending a statement of case, set out in Part 17, applies where a claimant abandons a claim for a particular remedy but wishes to continue with his claim for other remedies)

## Right to discontinue claim

## 38.2

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (1) At any time, a claimant may discontinue all or part of a claim against one or more defendants.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (2) However –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (a) a claimant must obtain the permission of the court if they wish to discontinue all or part of a claim in relation to which –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (i) the court has granted an interim injunction (GL) ; or

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (ii) any party has given an undertaking to the court;

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (b) where the claimant has received an interim payment in relation to a claim (whether voluntarily or pursuant to an order under Part 25), he may discontinue that claim only if –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (i) the defendant who made the interim payment consents in writing; or

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (ii) the court gives permission;

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (c) where there is more than one claimant, a claimant may not discontinue unless –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (i) every other claimant consents in writing; or

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.2] (ii) the court gives permission.

## Procedure for discontinuing

## 38.3

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (1) To discontinue a claim or part of a claim, a claimant must –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (a) file a notice of discontinuance; and

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (b) serve a copy of it on every other party to the proceedings.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (2) The claimant must state in the notice of discontinuance that they have served notice of discontinuance on every other party to the proceedings.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (3) Where the claimant needs the consent of some other party, a copy of the necessary consent must be attached to the notice of discontinuance.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (4) Where there is more than one defendant, the notice of discontinuance must specify against which defendants the claim is discontinued.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.3] (5) A notice of discontinuance must be in Form N279 unless the court permits otherwise.

## Right to apply to have notice of discontinuance set aside

## 38.4

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.4] (1) Where the claimant discontinues under rule 38.2(1) the defendant may apply to have the notice of discontinuance set aside (GL) .

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.4] (2) The defendant may not make an application under this rule more than 28 days after the date when the notice of discontinuance was served on them.

## When discontinuance takes effect where permission of the court is not needed

## 38.5

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.5] (1) Discontinuance against any defendant takes effect on the date when notice of discontinuance is served on them under rule 38.3(1).

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.5] (2) Subject to rule 38.4, claim is brought to an end as against that defendant on that date.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.5] (3) However, this does not affect proceedings to deal with any question of costs.

## Liability for costs

## 38.6

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (1) Unless the court orders otherwise, a claimant who discontinues is liable for the costs which a defendant against whom the claimant discontinues incurred on or before the date on which notice of discontinuance was served on the defendant.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (2) If proceedings are only partly discontinued –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (a) the claimant is liable under paragraph (1) for costs relating only to the discontinued part of the proceedings; and

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (b) unless the court orders otherwise, the costs which the claimant is liable to pay must not be assessed until the conclusion of the rest of the proceedings.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (3) This rule does not apply to claims allocated to the small claims track.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.6] (Rule 44.9 provides for the basis of assessment where the right to costs arises on discontinuance and contains provisions about when a costs order is deemed to have been made and applying for an order under section 194(3) of the Legal Services Act 2007)

## Discontinuance and subsequent proceedings

## 38.7

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (1) A claimant who discontinues a claim needs the permission of the court to make another claim against the same defendant if—

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (a )they discontinued the claim after the defendant filed a defence or, in a Part 8 claim, filed an acknowledgment of service or written evidence; and

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (b) the other claim arises out of facts which are the same or substantially the same as those relating to the discontinued claim.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (2) If the claimant considers that permission is needed, the application for permission shall be included in the claim form and claim will proceed only if permission is granted.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (3) The defendant shall inform the court in writing as soon as practicable whether the defendant asserts that permission is needed and, if so, whether the defendant consents to permission being granted.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (4) If the parties agree that permission should be granted, the court shall issue an order granting permission on the papers or make such other order as it thinks fit.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (5) If the parties disagree about whether permission should be granted, the court shall determine the issue either at a hearing or, in its discretion, on the papers after receiving written representations.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.7] (6) The defendant is not required to file an acknowledgment of service unless and until permission is granted.

## Stay of remainder of partly discontinued proceedings where costs not paid

## 38.8

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (1) This rule applies where –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (a) proceedings are partly discontinued;

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (b) a claimant is liable to –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (i) pay costs under rule 38.6; or

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (ii) make a payment pursuant to an order under section 194(3) of the Legal Services Act 2007; and

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (c) the claimant fails to pay those costs or make the payment within 14 days of –

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (i) the date on which the parties agreed the sum payable by the claimant; or

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (ii) the date on which the court ordered the costs to be paid or the payment to be made.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (2) Where this rule applies, the court may stay (GL) the remainder of the proceedings until the claimant pays the whole of the costs which the claimant is liable to pay under rule 38.6 or makes the payment pursuant to an order under section 194(3) of the Legal Services Act 2007.

[PART 38 – DISCONTINUANCE > 38.8] (Rules 44.9 and 46.7 contain provisions about applying for an order under section 194(3) of the Legal Services Act 2007.)
